text:
Rhea Kapoor: Quick sync 1 Optimize Toolkit MVP scope decision. Need clear cut: what do we ship in the next 6-week pilot? batching recs, caching TTLs, quant guidance (doc-only), eval-triggered alerts? @Ethan @Sofia

Ethan Morris: My vote: MVP = per-route batching recommendations + KV-prefix TTL suggestions + JSON exportable snippets. Eval-triggered alerts = webhook -> Slack only. Quantization automation is deferred; provide a short playbook instead. Keep UI table-only, no charts.

Sofia Alvarez: Agree. Add acceptance checks: recommender provides confidence score, expected cost % change, and p95 delta. Also include a short "why" sentence for each rec. Pilot gating: 2 pilots (one chat, one long-gen) + <1% absolute quality regression on paired-evals.

Ben Cho: From infra: need telemetry window (14 days) and a simulator to estimate latency impact before surfacing recs. Canary path should support applying recs to a traffic tag (2%). Also include p99 in reports 1 tails matter.

Rhea Kapoor: Draft acceptance criteria: (1) ranked recs for batching + caching with confidence and cost estimate; (2) exportable JSON snippets + Node/Python example; (3) eval webhooks to Slack; (4) docs + 2 pilots onboarded.

Ethan Morris: Timeline: recommender POC (2 sprints), export + SDK examples (0.5 sprint), simulator + eval webhook (1 sprint). If we need to cut, cut auto-quant.

Sofia Alvarez: UX note: provide "rollback recipe" text and a short checklist for pilot engineers (how to run paired-evals). I'll draft pilot prompts: 50 chat queries, 20 long-form examples, 10 adversarial checks.

Ben Cho: I'll add cost model hooks so exports include dollar estimates (using common cloud profiles). Also will ensure the simulator can run on sampled traces only (privacy).

tracker-bot: Created card OPT-6001 with subtasks: recommender-poc, simulator, sdk-snippets, eval-webhook, pilot-onboarding. Link: https://projects.internal/OPT-6001

Rhea Kapoor: Locked scope: suggest+export only; eval alerts to Slack; docs+2 pilots. Auto-apply and quant automation deferred. Action owners: @Ethan recommender, @Ben infra/simulator, @Sofia pilot docs. Thanks team :rocket:
